x.description: N-dimensional array for which the norm will be computed.

ord.description: specify the kind of norm to take. Default is Frobenius norm for matrices, and the 2-norm for vectors. For other options, see Notes below.

axis.description: integer or sequence of integers specifying the axes over which the norm will be computed. For a single axis, compute a vector norm. For two axes, compute a matrix norm. Defaults to all axes of ``x``.

keepdims.description: if True, the output array will have the same number of dimensions as the input, with the size of reduced axes replaced by ``1`` (default: False).

output.description: array containing the specified norm of x.
